We built Duo, a browser and desktop simulation of Apple’s foldable iPhone Duo.
What started as an experiment to explore foldable interfaces and screen transitions. Duo now includes folding and rotation, split-screen apps, camera access, an SDK, UI Kit, built-in apps, and a Store for submitting apps.

external.description: Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, appeared at the New York flagship Fifth Avenue store to personally welcome customers purchasing the newly released iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Dressed casually, he interacted warmly with fans, while the store buzzed with a festive atmosphere featuring a DJ booth playing Lady Gaga. Showcasing new colors and products like the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple looks ahead to the October release of the foldable iPhone Duo and further spring announcements.
